name: Builder-code order-routing businesses: terminals, bots, scanners, extensions, SDKs, white-label, US ISV
one_line: Stamp a builder code on other people's orders for up to 100/50 bps (two wallet apps charge 400) plus undisclosed weekly rewards, or declare vendor fees as a US ISV; the money is in distribution and the leaderboard counts shares, not dollars.
maturity: Established as a programme and for distribution owners and pro terminals (~550 codes, 610M shares routed 1-28 Sep 2026, fee-charging apps observable per fill); unproven for a new solo entrant; decayed for Telegram copy bots (-88% since April); US ISV route Emerging (beta docs)
edge: Venue subsidy plus an owned audience; users pay 50-400 bps for convenience
capital: none to <$1k for a code, bot or SDK; $10k+ only for custodial or US partner stacks
build_time: 1-2 weeks for an SDK or extension; 4-8 weeks for a bot or scanner with billing; 3-6 months for a US ISV
opportunity_size: 610M shares (~$250-300M notional) routed in Sep 2026, top-16 codes 79%; shrinking since June
expected_results: no public revenue data; derived: median verified code $35-100/month, 50th code $1.4-4k, wallet integrations ~$100-400k
competition: 301 active codes; betmoar, Gate, traderline, MetaMask, polymtrade; VC-funded terminals
flag: grey; non-custodial and geo-blocked is allowed, self-referred volume revocable, US needs ISV/IB or Letter 26-25
validate: Route own flow at 0 bps for a week, size competitors' notional from builder/trades, waitlist test, ask for the reward rate in writing
top_risk: Fee rights revocable at will; audience-less builders earn pocket money
solo_fit_reason: Free to start and the mechanics are fully public, but the median builder routes ~$10k of notional a month, the fee-charging incumbents own wallets and exchanges, pro terminals price at 0-10 bps, weekly rewards are undisclosed and revocable, and the copy-bot segment a solo developer could ship has lost 88% of its volume.
speed_class: speed-insensitive (fee accrues per fill); products inside are execution-sensitive
results_1k: workable as a side product; -$25 to +$80/month (derived from the median code)
results_10k: -$600 to +$10k/month for a niche terminal (guess, median near $0); six figures only with an owned audience
min_capital: ~$0-1k; users, not money, are the scarce input
capacity_ceiling: audience notional x 100 bps; whole programme ~$250-300M notional/month, top-16 take 79%
services: Polymarket builder profile + CLOB V2 SDK
monthly_running_cost: minimum ~$20-60; comfortable ~$200-600; US ISV adds counsel and a funding entity
changes_made: Written 2026-09-28 with live checks: builder leaderboards (MONTH/ALL/WEEK/DAY), the full /v1/builders/volume series since Oct 2025, builder/trades samples for 22 codes with fee bps and taker share, docs pages (fees, tiers, overview, analytics, combos builders, changelog), Polymarket US partner and vendor-fee docs, CFTC 9300-26, GitHub API, vendor pages, Chainstory, Unchained, TechCrunch, River Markets, kacho.io, Casino.org.

Established that the builder leaderboard and volume series are denominated in shares, not USDC: the sum of `size` over one UTC day reproduces the DAY series to the cent for five builders while USDC notional is 1.6-2.7x lower; the brief's '$440M/month' and '$6.97B lifetime' and E6's revenue estimates are share counts read as dollars.
Copy-bot decay extended to September: 125.2M (Apr) -> 15.3M shares (Sep), share of builder volume 21.1% -> 2.5%; programme peak June 1,493M shares / 66,944 users, September 610M / 36,826.
Recorded single-account 'builders' (MagicMarkets 28.3M shares from 1 user, Sharkbetting 2 users) as the self-attribution pattern of file 29.
Gate white-label offering documented as Gate DexBuilder's own Event Contracts Builder (search snippet), not verified as a Polymarket Builder Program product.

open_doubts: The weekly USDC reward rate and grant sizes are unpublished; '0.5-1% of attributed volume' is PolyTrack's back-calculation from one builder's reported revenue, and no builder discloses reward income.
Why MetaMask and RedotPay charge 400 bps (4x the documented cap) on both sides is unknown (partner terms?); E6 saw 0 bps on their sells on 2026-09-20, so the terms may have changed within the week.
Unverified builder codes are absent from every public series; their number and volume (the tier a solo entrant lives in) cannot be measured without scanning on-chain OrderFilled.builder.
Fee revenue figures apply 300-fill sampled rates and share/USDC ratios to a month of volume; the programme's September notional could be $200-350M.
CFTC Letter 26-25's numbered conditions are taken from E9's full-text reading and a fetched PDF whose condition list did not text-extract cleanly here.
Kairos, Paradigm and Kalshi terminal claims rest on headlines; no revenue or user numbers exist for any VC-funded terminal; the $5k / $10k rows are guesses with no disclosed comparable.
